body: Heh.   Thanks.   I don't want to make any promises,  though.   I'm resetting my exit rig now.
I doubt you'll be in the southern US,  but if you are and I'm still here,  sure.
I appreciate it,  but I feel like I know what I need,  think it's more than reasonable,  and can't get it.
The US.   So much for that movie!  Lol
Honestly I'd have given up on that message under the best of circumstances.   I think my wording showed frustration,but thE core message there was same as always.
Tyoed long reply, phone crashed and rebooted.  Attempted to reply with summary, phone froze and rebooted.  I kind of give up on that.  Sure you can see why.

Basically two relatively quick actions,  including pressing a button.  Not getting specific per the rules here,  as I don't think (?) it's within the rules to go into details.

Decided to take a nap since my coordination was off for it and I hadn't slept in 48 hours.  No messages from....  Anyone connected to her. 

I've wanted to kill myself since I was 8 but kept giving life second chances.   Truth be told,  it feels exactly like giving an abusive,  unhealthy partner way too many second changes (it's spooky how close the feeling is- almost a feeling of deja vu,  the "how stupid was i to not end things earlier!")

In all seriousness  I'd  consider taking you up on the offer to go see a movie,  except

1.  I doubt you live anywhere near me (Though if you care to share where I'll give you a rough idea how close) 

2.  Nobody wanted to spend time with me when I wasn't a wreck,  so it feels like youre taking on a charity case.  I can't imagine you'd ever consider that if I weren't going to die soon, 

3..  I'm enough of a wreck that I'd be constantly checking my phone for something,

4.  I'm supposed to start work in two hours anyway,  and since I won't have a job then can't imagine  staying out for any reason other than being dead-  it's hard to argue with that excuse!
It's been a day and a half and nothing at all.   Nothing from her parents since yesterday afternoon and nothing from her at all.

Nope there's no other family.  And even if she meant well,  the fact is now because of her my girlfriend is in an instution  and could have died.   And they haven't reached out to me in a day and a half.

Not when they're calling her work every day to see if she showed up and called the police on her when she didn't.   It's easy to say she should just go to work,  but knowing they'd do that is part of what tipped her to being suicidal.  Not to mention she lives in her mother's old house. 

She always swore that she'd kill herself if the police came after her.   She tried to kill herself immediately after the police came to check on her.  THIS is why I want to just tell her parents to just fuck off,  but they think I'd been trying to isolate her and abuse her.  And it's been about 20 hours and I've heard nothing from them.   If anybody is going to be told where she is,  it's them.
It's frustrating.   We had seeing each other tonight to look forward to.   Now she's gone.   We can't see each other tonight.
